title: IntegrationOps AI
subtitle: Enterprise Incident & Integration Intelligence Copilot
tagline: Evidence-grounded incident diagnosis with hybrid RAG, agent tools, and approval-gated remediation.
summary: A local enterprise incident intelligence platform that investigates API and integration failures by combining versioned runbooks, operational evidence, prior incidents, hybrid retrieval, structured diagnosis, citations, and explicit safety gates.
problem: Integration engineers often correlate logs, configuration changes, service status, runbooks, API documentation, and past incidents by hand. That slows diagnosis and makes evidence provenance difficult to review.
solution: IntegrationOps AI runs a controlled LangGraph workflow that classifies an incident, retrieves access-controlled evidence, calls read-only operational tools, ranks grounded hypotheses, validates citations, and returns recommended actions. A separate four-eyes workflow gates the single state-changing demo action.
highlights: Two-stage RAG: Qdrant dense and sparse reciprocal-rank fusion followed by cross-encoder reranking
Retrieval-time tenant, environment, and role filters
Evidence-linked hypotheses with citation integrity and fail-closed grounding checks
Read-only tools for logs, configuration changes, service status, and incident history
Four-eyes approval, audit events, and idempotency for a local remediation simulator
Offline evaluation, OpenTelemetry spans, durable persistence, migrations, and CI quality gates

verifiedMetrics.label: Mean reciprocal rank
verifiedMetrics.scope: 10-case synthetic benchmark with real local embedding and reranking models

disclosures: Uses synthetic enterprise evidence and local mock operational tools.
The remediation target is a local simulator, not a production integration.
Retrieval scores are regression results and must not be presented as production accuracy.
